THE SILENT BEHAVIOR
By Taylor Drummond, Carson Guise, Sophia Inglis, Claudia Zhu

What is Social Proof?
The psychological phenomenon where people mimic the actions of others in an attempt to reflect correct behavior in a given situation.

What Would a Tiger Do?
We asked our community if they would rather switch to the station that everyone else was on, or stick to the song they were previously enjoying...

Tigers Say...
After adding up our results from a handful of our fellow RIT students, we found that students would switch their station to the station of everyone else.

Our Question is...
After hearing our survey, would you switch the channel or march to the beat of your own drum?
